description: This file defines an abstract class Zend_Translate_Adapter for translation source adapters within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for managing translations, locales, caching, and loading translation data, serving as a base for specific translation adapters.

classes.name: Zend_Translate_Adapter
classes.description: Abstract class providing core functionality for translation adapters, including translation management, locale handling, caching, and data loading.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter, optionally loading cached translation data.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Adds translation data from a directory or array, with optional locale and options.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets adapter options such as locale, scan mode, and cache clearing.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves current options or a specific option value.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for translations, validating and adjusting as needed.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of available languages/locales.

methods.name: getMessageIds
methods.description: Returns message IDs for a given locale.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Returns all messages for a locale or the entire translation dictionary.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a locale is available.

methods.name: _loadTranslationData
methods.description: Abstract method to load translation data, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: _addTranslationData
methods.description: Internal method to add translation data for a locale, handling cache and automatic locale detection.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a message ID into the current locale.

methods.name: isTranslated
methods.description: Checks if a message ID has a translation in the current locale.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Sets a cache object for all adapters.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Abstract method to return the adapter's name.
